object_context: Strict analytic child of RH-ANA-002. The active object is the exact finite-prime contribution S_f(n) in the arithmetic Li-coefficient identity λ_n=S_∞(n)-S_f(n)+1. The cycle asks whether currently unconditional prime-number-theorem information yields a genuinely uniform-in-n one-sided control of the prime/archimedean cancellation, without substituting an RH-equivalent zero-location, Li-growth, Weil-positivity, or finite-prefix assumption.
structural_coordinates: all-index quantifier: any useful bridge must control every positive integer n rather than a computed prefix
Lagarias/Bombieri-Lagarias arithmetic formula is exact but highly regularized and cancellation-sensitive
for the trivial representation S_f(n)=Σ_{j=1}^n(-1)^{j-1} C(n,j)η_{j-1}, and the alternating signs cancel those in the prime-sum definition of η_{j-1}
the resulting prime weight is K_n(t)=Σ_{j=1}^n C(n,j)t^{j-1}/(j-1)!=L_{n-1}^{(1)}(-t), with positive coefficients for t≥0
the regularizing counterterm is L_n(-log N)-1=∫_1^N K_n(log x)dx/x
with ψ(x)=Σ_{m≤x}Λ(m) and E(x)=ψ(x)-x, the finite-place term is an exact regularized Stieltjes transform of dE
for fixed n, unconditional PNT error bounds are sufficient to kill the upper boundary term in integration by parts, yielding a signed transform of E(e^t)/e^t against W_n(t)=K_n(t)-K_n'(t)
current zero-free/zero-density technology supplies strong two-sided magnitude bounds for E(x), but a proof of Li positivity requires a one-sided or sufficiently small uniform-in-n transform bound
triangle-inequality use of a symmetric pointwise PNT-error envelope discards the arithmetic sign/correlation structure that may be load-bearing for the growing-degree kernels
numerical small-n behavior is calibration only and does not close the all-index residual
the exact transform is a localization of the existing cancellation obstruction, not a theorem that no explicit-formula/zero-density route can work
equivalent_formulations: RH: every nontrivial zero ρ of ζ has Re(ρ)=1/2
Li criterion: λ_n≥0 for every n≥1
arithmetic Li criterion: S_f(n)≤S_∞(n)+1 for every n≥1
prime-error transform form: after exact regularization and fixed-n integration by parts, the signed transform of E(e^t)/e^t against W_n(t) must satisfy the corresponding all-n upper bound
solved_analogues: fixed-degree Stieltjes transforms under the prime number theorem: for each fixed polynomial kernel, standard PNT error decay controls the boundary at infinity and gives a convergent error transform
exact background-subtraction identities in quadrature/explicit-formula settings, where a discrete measure minus its continuous reference measure is tested against a known kernel
near_solved_analogues: Bombieri-Lagarias/Lagarias arithmetic formulas for Li coefficients, which expose finite and archimedean places exactly but do not supply unconditional all-index positivity
modern zero-density plus zero-free-region results for ψ(x)-x, which give near-optimal pointwise magnitude decay but do not by themselves encode the signed correlation with the n-dependent Li kernel
Lagarias-Voros growth-class criteria, which replace sign-by-sign control with an all-index asymptotic exclusion but still require a root-strength uniform estimate

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A growing-order filter is applied to a signed residual after subtracting a reference background. A pointwise amplitude envelope can certify convergence for each fixed filter while becoming uninformative about the sign or magnitude of the family as filter order grows.
source_to_target_mapping: background subtraction -> prime sum minus continuous counterterm
shared_constraints: fixed-member convergence is weaker than family-uniform control
the target is a signed scalar functional
disanalogies: E is arithmetic and highly constrained rather than arbitrary noise
the target kernel comes from exact Li regularization
engineering conditioning estimates carry no RH authority
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Before spending effort on sharper pointwise PNT constants, test the induced family operator bound and identify whether missing sign/correlation information, rather than magnitude, is the true residual.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Derive the exact target transform from primary-source formulas; use hostile envelope alignment only to falsify envelope-only reasoning; any positive target claim must use zeta-specific evidence and an all-n proof.
